digest.component_or_area: metrics harvester adapter for GitHub Actions
propositions: New isolated GHA adapter must parse coverage percentage from pytest-cov TOTAL line in run-log tail and extract CI-health metadata (status, duration, red-to-green recovery, flake rate) from GitHub Actions API.

Harvester script must read recent test.yml run logs and metadata via gh CLI/Actions API, pass them through the adapter, and persist labeled snapshots to .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (not reports/).
Core metrics modules must not import the GHA adapter to maintain isolation and portability; the harvester is optional and run locally/by maintainer, not integrated into CI workflow.
Adapter must emit snapshots with appropriate source labels for red-to-green recovery intervals and recheck rates computed across fail-to-pass run pairs.
